context: User resumed active mature-0.x goal and requires devguide to be kept as implementation checkpoint at every increment.
question: Does one unchanged native feature inventory reused across two distinct reference inventories preserve full native correspondence/explicit-placement evidence relative to fresh extraction with identical settings?
evidence_class: Bounded classical subworkflow equivalence; not full RigidPoseSearch equivalence or a benchmark/biological study.
oracles: Source feature counts 2/4/3 in fixed CID order; identical feature definition/families/options in fresh and reused arms
Both references produce zero eligible three-feature association proposals for CID1983; this is proposal-family scope, not a new full screening claim
Identity mappings exist in each reference self-case and full fresh/reused proposal/placement reports agree
First canonical mapping only is fitted per query/arm. Record selected/omitted counts; empty accepted set with omitted proposals is not a compound negative
Three-of-four placement acceptance is separate from all-essential query evaluation
Source coordinates/maps and reused inventory remain unchanged; all three H5MSM bytes and historical capsule file identities unchanged
Per source outer extraction requests fresh2 versus reused1; native post-fit extraction continues. No time/memory speedup claim follows
Preserve actual native software/method attribution when available; source provenance from original PubChem receipt, no new acquisition
publication: Native feature/query/placement geometry and H5MSM remain local; publish owned code/control/scalar/citation projections only.
limitations: Unchanged same-source/frame/selection/state/chemistry/geometry is a caller precondition; no molecular snapshot/cache authentication added
Requested families declared separately; absence of records is not extraction coverage
No new public API/index/backend/dependency or provider/environment update
No equivalence claim for full seeded search, whole-library performance or biological prediction
pending_goal: Mature usable pre1.0 0.x through useful releases with exact source/installed/public gates. This experiment alone does not achieve that goal.
